metadata.scenario: A prospect reaches out to a financial advisory firm to understand what investment services are available for new clients. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Edward Martinez. I'm a regular client for respite care. Hi, Edward! It's great to hear from you. How can I assist you today? Well, I wanted to discuss some upcoming care for my wife. She has a couple of appointments next week. Absolutely, we can help with that. What days are you looking at? I need someone for Wednesday and Friday, preferably in the afternoons. Let me check the schedule. Our personal care assistants are available during those times. That would be great! I just want to make sure my wife is taken care of while I’m out. Of course, we understand how important that is. Would you like a caregiver who has experience with Parkinson's care? Yes, that would be ideal. She needs someone who understands her condition. I’ll ensure we assign a caregiver with that experience. The cost for personal care assistance is $28 to $35 per hour. That sounds reasonable. Can you confirm the total hours for each day? Typically, we schedule for 2 hours per visit. Would that work for you? Yes, that’s perfect. Great! So that's 2 hours on Wednesday and 2 hours on Friday. Right, so that’s 4 hours total. Yes, the total would be between $112 and $140 for both days. Alright, I can manage that. Excellent! Shall I go ahead and book those appointments for you? Yes, please do! I’ll confirm the schedule and send you a follow-up email with the details. That would be very helpful. Thank you! You're welcome! Is there anything else you need assistance with? Actually, I was wondering if you offer any additional services, like physical therapy? Yes, we do! Our physical therapy sessions are designed for rehabilitation and mobility improvement. What’s the pricing for that? The cost is $110 to $140 per session, lasting 45 to 60 minutes. That sounds good. I might be interested in that for her too. I can arrange a consultation to discuss that further if you'd like. Yes, I think that would be beneficial. Perfect! I’ll include that information in the follow-up email as well. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. My pleasure, Edward! We’re here to support you and your wife. Thank you again! You're welcome! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
